# EUR-Lex excerpt for tests (Articles 4, 5, 99 of the AI Act, abridged)

Licence note: EUR-Lex legal texts are reusable with acknowledgement
(Commission Decision 2011/833/EU); only the Official Journal is
authentic. This abridged test excerpt paraphrases the articles for
pipeline tests and carries no normative force.

## Article 4, paragraph 1 (address: article-4/para1)

Providers and deployers of AI systems shall take measures to ensure a
sufficient level of AI literacy of their staff and any other persons
dealing with the operation and use of AI systems on their behalf.

## Article 5, paragraph 1 (address: article-5/para1)

The following AI practices shall be prohibited: subliminal manipulation
causing significant harm, and social scoring leading to detrimental
treatment in unrelated contexts.

## Article 99, paragraph 4 (address: article-99/para4)

Non-compliance with the prohibited practices in Article 5 is subject to
administrative fines of up to 35 million euro or 7 percent of worldwide
annual turnover, whichever is higher.
